# Phoenix Station Standard Operating Procedure SOP is used to help ensure things flow naturally in the event of emergencies, and to help keep things fair between high-importance departments and the rest of the station, including antagonists.
## SOP always applies. For this reason, it is kept relatively simple.
# Station wide:
All standard crew requires permits to carry contraband, minor is permissible depending on circumstances but should still have a permit
